first.rationale: Onboarding simplification directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also help recover activation, while prior promotional pricing harmed 30-day retention despite acquisition gains. Verify the strongest evidence for onboarding and the key sustainability risk of the pricing alternative before committing. Measure qualified revenue and retention, not only completion or activation.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified prior test improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Reject promotional pricing for this slot because its 18% qualified-revenue lift came with a 12% retention decline and failure at first renewal. Track onboarding completion, first meaningful activation, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue.
